data.summary: Two distinct full-body fighters and a coherent neon street are maintained. After an initial swing/block they separate and exchange again, violating the single-action requirement. The final held silver and blue blades are clear of both faces, without the persistent fork seen in SX.

observations.text: The two fighters face each other and begin approaching; no character sheet or extra person appears.
A swing and block complete around 2.2 s, then the weapons separate and the fighters wind up again.
A second exchange occurs around 3.4–3.7 s before a stable crossed-blade hold. Both whole bodies stay in view, and the two weapons remain distinct while the cloak moves.
